title: Hecuba chooses the robe
intro: Hector repeats Helenus' instructions, then turns bitterly to Paris. Hecuba selects the finest offering.

notes.text: ἔρχομαι uncontracted 2sg pres imperative; θύος, burnt offering / incense: dat pl -εσσι.
ἀολλίζω, gather together: aor act ptc nom fem sg; γεραιαί, elder women.
Fronted robe resumed by τόν; τίθημι 2sg aor imperative, place. The intervening relative picks the finest and largest.
χαρίεις, lovely / graceful: superlative; πολὺ φίλτατος (272), by far most cherished.
γόνυ dat pl; ἠΰκομος, lovely-haired: gen sg of Athena. Offering on the statue's knees.
ὑπισχνέομαι, promise: 2aor mid inf used as command; alternates with imperative θές.
Yearling cattle, never goaded / worked; ἱερεύω, sacrifice: epic fut inf after promise. Compare the same wording at 93–94.

notes.lemma: αἴ κ᾽ ἐλεήσῃ … αἴ κεν … ἀπόσχῃ
notes.text: ἐλεέω aor subj, pity; ἀπέχω 2aor subj, keep away. Hoped-for divine response, both 3sg.
μήστωρ, deviser / master: acc sg; φόβος, rout / panic. Diomedes' terrifying reputation persists.
ἔρχευ contracted 2sg imperative of ἔρχομαι; μετέρχομαι, go after: 1sg fut mid, μετ-ελεύσ-.
καλέω, call / summon: epic 1sg aor subj with -σσ-, purpose.
ἐθέλω 3sg pres subj -ῃσι, elided; ἀκούω pres inf -έμεν; “if he is willing to listen.” εἰπόντος gen ptc, to me speaking.

notes.lemma: ὥς κέ οἱ αὖθι γαῖα χάνοι
notes.text: χάσκω, gape: 3sg 2aor opt; impassioned wish, “if only the earth would swallow him here!”
τρέφω, rear: 3sg impf; πῆμα, bane / affliction (neut), predicate to Paris. Zeus raised him as Troy's bane.
τοῖο, epic gen sg demonstrative, “his,” Priam's; παῖς dat pl.
εἶδον 1sg 2aor opt; φημί 1sg pres opt + κε. “If I saw … I would say…”
“Into Hades' [house]”; gen with εἴσω, dwelling understood.
ἄτερπος, joyless; ὀϊζύς, misery: gen sg. ἐκλανθάνομαι perf mid inf, utterly forget; φρένα acc subject, my heart.
βλώσκω, go: 2aor ptc nom fem sg, stem μολ-; ποτί = πρός.
ἀμφίπολος, attendant: dat pl; κέλομαι reduplicated 3sg aor mid, called to.
ἀολλίζω, gather: unaugmented 3pl aor; they gather the elder women throughout the city.
καταβαίνω 3sg aor mid, went down; κηώεις, fragrant: acc masc sg with chamber.
All-patterned / richly embroidered works; describes the robes.
Sidonian women; -θεν, from Sidon. These skilled women came with Paris from the Levant.
ἐπιπλέω, sail over: 2aor act ptc nom sg, athematic stem πλω-.
“On that journey on which…”; acc of time / course. εὐπατέρεια, noble-born: acc fem sg, Helen.
ἀείρω, lift / take up: aor mid ptc nom fem sg; she selects one robe.
ποίκιλμα, embroidery / patterned work: dat pl of respect; most beautiful in its embroidery.
ἀπολάμπω, shine out: 3sg impf, like a star; νείατος, bottommost, beneath the other robes.
βαίνω root aor, set off; μετασεύομαι, hurry after: unaugmented 3pl impf mid, epic -σσ-.
